Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy. 

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a thermally conductive binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive solder paste. 

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy. 

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, wherein the binder is a thermally conductive epoxy.
